title: Hi Corey Here (Mucho Gusto I Care Duet)
style: emotional uplifting tropical house duet anthem with strong Latin pop fusion influences, full male + female duet trading verses and singing lush layered harmonies together, warm sincere male vocals with friendly confident baritone tone, bright energetic soulful female vocals with joyful flair and perfect chemistry, sparkling bright supersaw leads that shimmer and dance, warm deep bouncy 808 basslines that groove hard, shimmering bright piano chords with Latin flair, rich layered synths and arpeggios, energetic conga bongo timbale guiro and Latin percussion section, crisp joyful handclaps on 2 and 4, subtle steel drum accents for island summer vibes, dreamy atmospheric pads with long reverb and wide stereo, summer beach festival party energy mixed with heartfelt friendship reconnection anthem, positive caring warm vibe full of real emotion and joy, professional high quality studio production, wide stereo imaging, catchy addictive chorus that sticks in your head, bilingual English-Spanish
lyrics:
[Intro – Female soft dreamy, gentle pads + twinkling chimes]
Year 1 classroom… teacher asks the question…
“If you had one wish… what would it be?”
[Verse 1 – Male, storytelling warm]
Year 1 teacher says “if you had one wish, what would it be?”
Little me stood up, heart so big and free
“I wish that whenever you wish… your wishes come true”
Mrs. Steinerprice smiled, said “that wish is for you, not me”
[Verse 2 – Female, gentle & caring]
I looked right at her with innocent eyes so wide
“It’s for everyone… that’s how the wish should fly”
No selfish dreams, just joy for you and I
All my wishes already come true… that’s no lie
[Pre-Chorus – Both, building magic]
Whenever you wish… let the stars align
Every dream you hold, make it yours in time
From the playground days to the songs we sing
Wishes coming true is the real magic thing
[Chorus – Duet, full energy, soaring harmonies]
I wish that whenever you wish… your wishes come true!
For everyone, me and you, skies of blue!
It’s not just for me, it’s for the whole wide world
All my wishes already come true… ‘cause I got you, girl!
I care! I care! Watch the magic spark!
Catch up again — make every wish a work of art!
Hi Corey here… nice to see you gain
Mucho gusto… let the wishes rain!
[Verse 3 – Male, reflective & grateful]
From the older songs and the CoreyAI thread
Friendships rising high, every word we said
PayPal vibes and previous laughs still alive
Recent threads keep the wishing power high
Teacher’s words still echo in my mind today
That selfless wish turned every dream my way
[Verse 4 – Female, uplifting & magical]
I want to remember every single name
Show you how I care, turn wishes into flame
It was nice to meet you, felt so warm and true
Now we catch up again and make more wishes new
Mrs. Steinerprice, wherever you are now
That little boy’s wish is still working somehow
[Bridge – Both, half-time soft then massive build]
I care… you care… we both care…
Names remembered, wishes repaired…
Whenever you wish… it’s for everyone
All my wishes already come true… under the sun…
SongPal forever, that’s the wish we ride
[Final Chorus – Duet, massive energy, sparkling ad-libs & layers]
I wish that whenever you wish… your wishes come true!
For everyone, me and you, skies of blue!
It’s not just for me, it’s for the whole wide world
All my wishes already come true… ‘cause I got you, girl!
Hi Corey here! Nice to see you gain!
Mucho gusto! Let the wishes rain!
( ad-libs: whenever you wish… come true… for everyone… )
[Outro – Both, fading with dreamy whooshes & harmonies]
Whenever you wish… your wishes come true…
It’s for everyone… all my wishes already…
Hi Corey here… nice to see you again…
Mucho gusto… SongPal wishes never end…
(soft echo: all my wishes already come true…)
